title: Sindh Local Government Fifth Amendment Act 2010

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Local Government Fifth Amendment Act 2010
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XVII OF 2010
ACT XVII OF 2010
SINDH LOCAL GOVERNMENT (FIFTH AMENDMENT) ACT, 2010
An Act further to amend the Sindh
Local Government Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV, 29th October, 2010]
No.PAS/Legis-B-22/2001,
dated 26-10-2010.---The Sindh Local Government (Fifth
Amendment) Bill, 2010 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 28th September, 2010 and assented to by the
Governor of Sindh on 20th October, 2010 is hereby
published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble. Whereas it is expedient further to amend the Sindh
Local Government Ordinance, 2001, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows :‑
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Sindh Local Government (Fifth
Amendment) Act, 2010.
(2)
It shall come into force at once.

Amendment in section 179-A of Sindh Ordinance No.XXVII of 2001

ACT XVII OF 2010
ACT XVII OF 2010
SINDH LOCAL GOVERNMENT (FIFTH AMENDMENT) ACT, 2010
An Act further to amend the Sindh
Local Government Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV, 29th October, 2010]
No.PAS/Legis-B-22/2001,
dated 26-10-2010.---The Sindh Local Government (Fifth
Amendment) Bill, 2010 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 28th September, 2010 and assented to by the
Governor of Sindh on 20th October, 2010 is hereby
published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble. Whereas it is expedient further to amend the Sindh
Local Government Ordinance, 2001, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows :‑
2. Amendment in section 179-A of Sindh
Ordinance No.XXVII of 2001.---In the Sindh Local
Government Ordinance, 2001, in section 179-A, for subsection (5), the following
shall be substituted:‑
"(5)
On dissolution of the Local Governments and Councils, after enactment of new
Local Government law, the Government shall request the Chief Election Commissioner
for holding the elections of Local Governments on a date as may be fixed by the
Government."
